name: manual_1d7c9a
claim: When wiring code-review-graph (CRG) MCP server to Claude Code, use the global ~/.claude.json with the same uvx/ollama/bge-m3 config used in the project-level .mcp.json. CRG runs via uvx code-review-graph serve, not as a standalone binary. The env vars PYTHON, CRG_OPENAI_API_KEY=ollama, CRG_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1, CRG_OPENAI_MODEL=bge-m3, CRG_OPENAI_DIMENSION=1024, and CRG_ACCEPT_CLOUD_EGRESS=1 must match exactly for embeddings to work.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14: CRG was configured in OpenClaw/.mcp.json and .codex/mcp.json but missing from ~/.claude.json, so Claude Code could not reach it globally. The project-level config had the correct uvx env setup; the global config needed the same block.
